current.text: Isaiah Jackson is starting over Lopez at center in Clippers preseason scrimmages. This is not guaranteed to continue.
He projects as the Clippers' backup center in a mentoring role until Konan Niederhauser returns.
He is 38 and in the final year of his contract.
Konan Niederhauser, the other Clippers center option, is injured. Ivica Zubac has been traded.
Do not draft him inside the top 200. His ESPN rank of 112 and ADP of 109 are too high.
At 30 minutes a night he would be a late-round draftable player. If his minutes are split down to about 22, he has no fantasy value.
The Clippers coach never gives his centers heavy minutes, which caps Lopez even if he wins back the starting job.
The Clippers project as one of the worst teams and lean toward a trial season with long rotations and many players tested.
The Clippers play 4, 3 and 4 games in our playoff weeks and have only 13 back-to-backs, one of the lowest totals in the league.

durable.text: His fantasy value comes from blocks and threes for a center, with few turnovers. He is weak in steals and rebounds for a center.
He still contests shots at the rim but is weak defending the pick and roll.
His free throw shooting fell off badly last season.
He is in age decline and his production dropped off badly last season.
Clippers coach Ty Lue makes odd rotation choices and then changes them.
